mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_gap (question, answer, source, urls, search_count, status) VALUES (#{question}, #{answer}, #{source}, #{urls}, 1, 'pending') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE search_count = search_count + 1, answer = VALUES(answer), source = VALUES(source), urls = VALUES(urls)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM knowledge_gap WHERE status = 'pending' ORDER BY search_count DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_gap WHERE status = 'pending'
SELECT * FROM knowledge_gap WHERE status = 'ignored' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_gap WHERE status = 'ignored'
SELECT source AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM knowledge_gap WHERE status = 'pending' GROUP BY source
SELECT * FROM knowledge_gap WHERE question = #{question} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_gap SET status = #{status}, category = #{category}, keywords = #{keywords}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, review_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
